about: English 120-second cut. Reuses the first 75 seconds and verified footage of the 90-second version, then adds company formats, shared standards and contribution credit. Spec: docs/demo/hackathon-120s.md.

en.cap: Every document starts from zero.
Find a format. Plan the outline. Gather sources. Fix the style.
Then explain all of it to your AI. Again.
One sentence. Three documents. Three websites.
In Arise Browser, an agent works on each one.
But first, it asks Document Memory.
Three workflows. Recorded separately in Arise.
Each asks for the format and the sources.
It returns structure, citations, and open questions.
en.vo: It returns the structure, the citations, and a flag on anything still unconfirmed.

en.cap: So they write instead of guessing.
en.vo: So they write instead of guessing. The Slides window is a real run from an earlier project, fast-forwarded.

en.cap: Docs, deck and post. Ready for your review.
en.vo: A one-pager, a ten-slide deck, and a blog post, ready for your review.

en.cap: Templates live in a shared library, with credit attached.
en.vo: Templates live in a shared library, with author, version and license attached. Your references stay private.

en.cap: Copy one, and your agent starts from a good structure.
Different companies. Different document standards.
en.vo: Every company has its own reports, proposals, and ways of writing.

en.cap: Keep their formats together in your template library.
en.vo: Keep their reusable formats in your library, ready for your AI.

en.cap: One link. A shared standard for your AI.
en.vo: Give your AI a link to the public template you want to reuse.

en.cap: Consistent standards across document tools.
en.vo: Reuse your structure, writing patterns, and design guidance across tools.

en.cap: Contribute a memory that helps the next person.
en.vo: Contribute useful document memory for others to find and reuse.

en.cap: Approved public templates earn leaderboard points.
en.vo: Approved public templates earn twenty points on the leaderboard.

en.cap: Every reuse skips the setup.
Ten minutes saved, a thousand reuses: about 167 hours.
en.vo: Say each reuse saves ten minutes. A thousand reuses: about 167 hours. A what-if, not a measurement.

en.cap: Share the memory. Save the time.
en.vo: My Document Memory. Share the memory. Save the time.

footage.note: Files are relative to demo/out/. speed is the playback factor of the prepared clip; 'from'/'to' are video seconds. Docs and Blog are edited public Arise MCP viewport recordings (prep-arise.py); each edit manifest retains the original timestamps. Product clips are scripted clicks on the real app (capture-product.mjs); Slides is a real agent run from the WAM project (prep-slides.mjs). The runs were recorded separately.
footage.disclosure: Docs and Blog: real Arise captures, edited. Runs recorded separately. Slides: earlier project. New feature scenes: illustrations with example data.

reputation.rule: 20 points per approved public template · public profile is opt-in
